name: Gydolien Mor
description: Spellcaster of Khone who forced the dragon back and plotted revenge on Chondeah.

description_citations.text: "Sol'Kanar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gydolien Mor and Chondeah summon the last Scarzam dragon with Sivitri riding it; she attacks Sol'Kanar.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gydolien takes control of Sivitri's dragon, which returns through the portal with Sivitri; Sol'Kanar orders Gydolien's home Khone scoured.
timeline.quote: Gydolien intervened by taking control of Sivitri's dragon, instructing it to leave.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar, Chondeah and Gydolien summon a Scarzam Dragon ridden by Sivitri, who attacks him; Gydolien forces them back and Sol'Kanar destroys Khone in a rage.
timeline.quote: destroyed the kingdom of Khone in a rage

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Numbered Ones destroy a Yalomar cat with magic, blinding the Khonian midwives and killing all but Gydolien Mor.
timeline.quote: When the Numbered Ones managed to destroy it with magic, the resulting blast blinded the Khonian midwives and killed all but one of the Numbered Ones, leaving only Gydolien Mor alive.

citation.text: "Cat", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The only one of the Numbered Ones to survive the destruction of a Yalomar cat.
